items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Lionel and I had a contract with Sebastian, too.

ctx.x: The Cotton Club was run by Frank Sebastian.
Frank Sebastian, yes. The man that loved lights. He had lights all over the place. And neon lights and every light you could imagine. He was very -- well, he was a beautiful fellow. He was real fine.
He also hired bands from out of town. That were traveling, weren't they?
